builds_conclusion_check.name: builds_conclusion_check
builds_conclusion_check.value: conclusion is null or conclusion in ('no_changes', 'changes_detected')

builds_baseline_source_check.name: builds_baseline_source_check
builds_baseline_source_check.value: baseline_source is null or baseline_source in ('cli', 'sdk', 'provider', 'fallback', 'none')

builds_parallel_check.name: builds_parallel_check
builds_parallel_check.value: ("builds"."parallel_nonce" is null) = ("builds"."parallel_total" is null) and ("builds"."parallel_total" is null or "builds"."parallel_total" >= 1)

comments_region_check.name: comments_region_check
comments_region_check.value:
("comments"."region_x" is null and "comments"."region_y" is null and "comments"."region_width" is null and "comments"."region_height" is null)
        or ("comments"."snapshot_name" is not null
          and "comments"."region_x" >= 0 and "comments"."region_y" >= 0
          and "comments"."region_width" > 0 and "comments"."region_height" > 0
          and "comments"."region_x" + "comments"."region_width" <= 1 and "comments"."region_y" + "comments"."region_height" <= 1)

integration_links_project_subject_key.name: integration_links_project_subject_key
integration_links_project_subject_key.where: "integration_links"."build_id" is null and "integration_links"."project_id" is not null

review_requests_snooze_kind_check.name: review_requests_snooze_kind_check
review_requests_snooze_kind_check.value: snooze_kind is null or snooze_kind in ('next_push', 'tomorrow', 'next_week', 'date')

screenshot_diffs_status_check.name: screenshot_diffs_status_check
screenshot_diffs_status_check.value: status is null or status in ('added', 'removed', 'changed', 'unchanged', 'failed')

triage_items_assignment_source_check.name: triage_items_assignment_source_check
triage_items_assignment_source_check.value: assignment_source is null or assignment_source in ('auto', 'manual')

triage_items_snooze_kind_check.name: triage_items_snooze_kind_check
triage_items_snooze_kind_check.value: snooze_kind is null or snooze_kind in ('next_push', 'tomorrow', 'next_week', 'date')
